trl-distillation-trainer.label: TRL DistillationTrainer

on-policy-distillation.label: On-policy distillation
on-policy-distillation.summary: Distillation setup where the student generates its own rollouts during training while the teacher scores those exact rollouts with log-probabilities, letting the student learn from self-generated mistakes instead of only imitating teacher trajectories.

off-policy-distillation.label: Off-policy distillation
off-policy-distillation.summary: Distillation setup where a teacher generates completions for prompts and the student trains on those teacher-generated trajectories, using hard generated tokens or soft teacher output distributions.

generation-buffer.label: Generation buffer
generation-buffer.summary: Throughput optimization that accumulates prompts across a gradient-accumulation window, generates student rollouts in one larger vLLM batch, then consumes buffered rollouts through sequential forward/backward training steps without changing the policy before the optimizer step.

teacher-server-logprob-serving.label: Teacher-server logprob serving
teacher-server-logprob-serving.summary: External vLLM teacher server pattern where training workers query a large teacher model for token-level log-probabilities, enabling 100B+ teachers that cannot be colocated with student training GPUs.

request-batching-for-teacher-logprobs.label: Request batching for teacher logprobs
request-batching-for-teacher-logprobs.summary: Server-side batching layer that queues concurrent worker requests for a few milliseconds or until sequence/token limits are reached, combines them into one vLLM call, and splits results back to workers, reducing tail latency by about 10x in the article's setup.

binary-logprob-encoding.label: Binary logprob encoding
binary-logprob-encoding.summary: Payload optimization that packs top-k log-probabilities and token IDs into preallocated NumPy arrays shaped (batch, max_completion_len, top_k), base64-encodes them for JSON transport, and avoids nested list/Pydantic overhead.

top-k-kl-approximation.label: Top-k KL approximation
top-k-kl-approximation.summary: Approximation that computes distillation divergence over only the highest-probability token IDs at each step because full-vocabulary logprob comparison can require massive tensors, e.g. about 150 million log-probabilities for a 1k-token Qwen sample with a 150k vocabulary.

forward-kl-divergence.label: Forward KL divergence
forward-kl-divergence.summary: Divergence direction used in distillation where the teacher distribution is treated as the reference; with top-k approximation, the compared token IDs are selected from the teacher's highest log-probabilities.

reverse-kl-divergence.label: Reverse KL divergence
reverse-kl-divergence.summary: Divergence direction used in distillation that focuses on student log-probabilities; with top-k approximation, the compared token IDs are selected from the student's highest log-probabilities.

capacity-gap-in-distillation.label: Capacity gap in distillation
capacity-gap-in-distillation.summary: Observed limitation where a much larger teacher does not always yield proportionally better students because the smaller student may not absorb all additional teacher capability; the article reports similar AIME25 distilled-student levels from 30B and 235B Qwen teachers and a GPQA drop with the 235B teacher after step 40.

domain-specific-reasoning-distillation.label: Domain-specific reasoning distillation

vllm-batched-inference-engine.label: vLLM batched inference engine

qwen3-235b-teacher-distillation.label: Qwen3 235B teacher distillation

graphrag-query-focused-summarization.label: GraphRAG (Graph RAG)
graphrag-query-focused-summarization.summary: Graph-based RAG approach that answers global sensemaking questions over an entire private corpus by building an LLM-derived entity knowledge graph, partitioning it into a hierarchy of communities, pregenerating community summaries, and answering queries via map-reduce over those summaries.

global-sensemaking-qfs.label: Global sensemaking / query-focused summarization

conventional-vector-rag.label: Conventional vector RAG
conventional-vector-rag.summary: Baseline retrieval-augmented generation that fetches text chunks most similar to a query into the LLM context window; effective for local fact-finding but unable to support sensemaking over an entire corpus when the source exceeds the context window.

entity-knowledge-graph-index.label: LLM-derived entity knowledge graph index
entity-knowledge-graph-index.summary: Graph index built by prompting an LLM to extract entities (nodes), relationships (edges), and covariates/claims from source text chunks, with duplicate relationships aggregated into edge weights — a form of abstractive summarization of the corpus.

leiden-hierarchical-community-detection.label: Leiden hierarchical community detection
leiden-hierarchical-community-detection.summary: Community-detection step that partitions the entity graph into nested modular communities of closely related nodes using the Leiden algorithm recursively, exploiting graph modularity to create a hierarchy from leaf-level to higher-level communities.

community-summaries.label: Community summaries
community-summaries.summary: Report-like summaries pregenerated by the LLM for each graph community, built bottom-up so higher-level summaries recursively incorporate lower-level element summaries; together they give global descriptions and insights over the corpus.

map-reduce-answer-generation.label: Map-reduce community answering

GraphRAG answers queries through map-reduce processing of community summaries.
